summary: Iteration 63: Mensagens Admin Feature - Complete Testing. All 15 backend tests PASSED. Frontend UI fully functional. Admin can send messages to athletes with various filters (Todos, Por Modalidade, Por Gênero, Grupos Especiais). Athletes receive messages as notifications in the bell icon.

✅ GET /api/admin/mensagens/contagem-destinatarios - returns correct counts for all filter types
✅ Frontend DashboardMensagens.jsx has all required data-testid attributes
✅ NotificacoesBell.jsx correctly displays admin messages with link and anexos support
⚠️ WebSocket connection failing with 403 (pre-existing issue, not related to this feature)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mensagens Admin feature is fully implemented and tested. Admin can send messages to athletes with filters: Todos (449 atletas), Por Modalidade (profissional_amador, povao_pace_livre), Por Gênero (M, F, PCD M/F, Cadeirante M/F), Grupos Especiais (donos_assessoria, individual_sem_assessoria). Messages appear in athlete's notification bell. The feature is accessible via Admin > Gestão > Mensagens.
